items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not speak. The relationship described ('friend') is between the interviewer's brother and Ben Cofer.

ctx.x: But also you said that he had just played it around school; he didn't play it professionally. He didn't ever play any jobs with it, just as a hobby.
The only job that I can remember him playing was out in Decatur. They played in a hall one night. I think that's how he happened to pick up this trombone, he and his friend, Ben (Cofer.)
